evaluation_kind: Agreement with automatic CTC teacher labels; not human-verified lip-sync accuracy
breath_note: The breath label includes /h/. Natural inhalations are not annotated or independently validated.

validity: INVALID: Japanese teacher preprocessing used normalization although do_normalize=false. Do not treat these scores as current performance.
